author: Pablo & Claude
description: Color blindness correction (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia), saturation, contrast, brightness, sharpness and vignette for the 3D view, in the VISUAL FILTERS settings tab. Changes apply after restarting the game; needs HDR on. Overrides the game shader post_hdr_compose.fs in memory (only when a filter is on): re-check after game patches. Translations are automatic (AI) and may contain errors.
